name: Bread Barbershop
description: Meet Bread! He's a brilliant cake decorator who gives amazing makeovers to customers in a town inhabited by quirky little food characters.

videos.title: Best Cupcake
videos.overview: After getting bullied, a cupcake visits Bread Barbershop to see if the master barber can create a hairstyle that disguises his unusually large head.

videos.title: Munchkin Donut / Bread's Hairstyling Class 1
videos.overview: Bread meets his match with a cranky young client who doesn't want to get his hair cut. Can the master cut through all the crying?

videos.title: Heavy Metal / Bread's Hairstyling Class 2
videos.overview: A heavy metal band hopes a makeover from Master Bread will make them more popular with fans — but there's a musical mix-up at the barber shop.

videos.title: Job Test / Bread's Hairstyling Class 3
videos.overview: When Master Bread decides to hire an assistant to help out around the shop, an overeager milk carton named Wilk makes a mess of the job test.

videos.title: Bully Pie / Bread's Hairstyling Class 4
videos.overview: A pie on the run visits Bread Barbershop hoping a new look will make him unrecognizable to the police — but Bread has no idea he's aiding a criminal.

videos.title: Hello Sausage / Bread's Hairstyling Class 5
videos.overview: Wilk takes in a lost sausage dog despite Master Bread's "no dogs in the shop" rule. But the pup might be better for business than Bread imagined.

videos.title: Chippy Customer
videos.overview: A rival hair salon is stealing all of Bread Barbershop's business! When Wilk and Choco investigate, they discover the rotten truth.

videos.title: Butter Fingers
videos.overview: Movie star Butter has everything: fame, fortune — and slippery fingers. Luckily Bread has some ideas to help the handsome celeb get a hold of his career.

videos.title: A Home for Wilk
videos.overview: When Wilk's landlord raises his rent, he has to find a new place to live — and fast. Unfortunately, the real estate market is not in Wilk's favor.

videos.title: Master Barber
videos.overview: A popular TV show wants to feature Bread Barbershop, but Master Bread isn't sure he wants the publicity — until the director mentions money.

videos.title: Wilk's Story
videos.overview: Wilk tells Choco the story of how he learned to accept his misspelled label with the help of an unexpected mentor.

videos.title: Camembert Cheese
videos.overview: Wilk brings Cheese to Bread Barbershop to see if Master Bread can do something about his Camembert stench, which he's been bullied for all his life.

videos.title: Soboro Ppang's Crush
videos.overview: When Soboro scores a date with a pretty cookie, he visits Bread Barbershop for a makeover — but he only has three hours before his new look will fade.

videos.title: Every Sausage Has His Day
videos.overview: A mysterious bun who can predict the future tells the barbershop crew that Sausage's rightful owner will live a rich life. But who is Sausage's owner?

videos.title: Tea Master
videos.overview: Wilk doesn't know how to make tea! After taking lessons with a great master, the young milk must make a cup for his harshest critic: Master Bread.

videos.title: The Magic Scissors
videos.overview: Wilk finds a pair of enchanted scissors that grant him a special gift. When the town takes notice, Master Bread must get used to being second best.

videos.title: Intern's Secret
videos.overview: An inept intern applies for a position at the barbershop, but when Master Bread finds out her true identity, he offers her a job on the spot.

videos.title: Chip's Plot
videos.overview: Potato Chip offers Wilk more money to come work at his hair shop, but he may have overestimated how valuable the young assistant is as an employee.

videos.title: Lonely Tart
videos.overview: Master Bread doesn't care to appear on a makeover show that transforms people's lives, until he hears about the grand prize: a brand new sports car.

videos.title: Choco Smile
videos.overview: When Bread Barbershop loses out on free money because of Choco's unhappy face, Master Bread organizes a "Make Choco Smile" contest.

videos.title: Sausage's Christmas / Chip's Christmas
videos.overview: Everyone at the barbershop has plans for Christmas — except Sausage. But on Christmas Eve, the pup gets an unexpected visit from a very special pastry.

videos.title: Dishelin Stars
videos.overview: A notorious critic makes an unscheduled visit to Bread Barbershop. Master Bread must be on his best behavior if he wants to get a good review.

videos.title: Employee of the Month
videos.overview: Wilk wants to be Employee of the Month more than anything, but the harder he tries to impress Master Bread, the further he gets from the title.

videos.title: Movie Star Bread
videos.overview: Master Bread and Wilk score roles in the new "Donut Ranger" movie, but they'll have to get their acts together if they want to make the final cut.

videos.title: Soccer King Bread
videos.overview: When the Bakery Town soccer team announces tryouts, Wilk asks Master Bread to train him — and quickly learns his new coach has some unusual methods.

videos.title: My Love, Choco
videos.overview: Wilk's friend, Milk Toast, falls head over heels for Choco. But he's not her type! What must Milk Toast do to earn Choco's love?

videos.title: The Chess King
videos.overview: Sausage can beat every Bread Barbershop employee at chess, but how will he do in a tournament against the cheating chess champion, Potato Chip?

videos.title: Sushi Tourists
videos.overview: Sushi friends are coming to the Bakery Town for a trip! However, their hair gets stolen by Chip without them noticing it. Maybe they are too excited traveling around. Can Sushi friends get their hair back?

videos.title: Barbershop Pup
videos.overview: The Bread Barbershop crew thinks Sausage has it easy, but the little dog helps out around the shop more than they realize.

videos.title: Bread's Date / Meet Tiramisu Again
videos.overview: When Wilk burns out from working overtime, he and Choco decide to find Bread a girlfriend so the boss will have a reason to leave work early.

videos.title: The Queen's Diet
videos.overview: Cake Queen wants to look slimmer for her first public appearance in 10 years. If Master Bread can't help her, she'll send him to the dungeon!

videos.title: Bread's Birthday
videos.overview: Wilk worries Master Bread won't have the best birthday ever, so he goes the extra mile to make his boss feel special — but he might've gone too far.

videos.title: The Queen's Pet
videos.overview: The Cake Queen is offering a $10,000 reward to whomever finds her missing dog — who happens to look a lot like Sausage. Can Wilk keep his dog safe?

videos.title: The Dark Wilk Rises
videos.overview: Wilk's gone bad! The usually upbeat assistant is acting rotten and no one can figure out why. Can the shop clients fix him before it's too late?

videos.title: April Fool's Day
videos.overview: It's April Fools' Day, and Choco and Master Bread want to prank Wilk by pretending Bread has a fever. But the boss may be a little too good of an actor.

videos.title: A Bun to Remember / Rival, Baguette
videos.overview: Master Bread recounts the story of how he found his destiny as a hairdresser with the help of his mentor, a stylist named Sweet Bun.

videos.title: Bread and Baguette, Part 1
videos.overview: Potato Chip suggests having a contest to find out who's the best barber in town — Bread or Baguette — and awakens a decades-old rivalry.

videos.title: Bread and Baguette, Part 2
videos.overview: Baguette and Potato Chip have put Bread Barbershop out of business! And now with no competition, greedy Chip raises the price of haircuts tenfold.

videos.title: Bread and Baguette, Part 3
videos.overview: Bread and Baguette compete in the ultimate battle to find out once and for all who will go down as the best hairdresser in Bakery Town.

videos.title: The Barber of Bakery Town / Hardtack
videos.overview: With the goal of saving his father's barbershop, Young Hardtack challenges Master Bread to a match to become the new best barber in town.

videos.title: Choco's Job Interview / Chocolate
videos.overview: When Wilk wonders how Choco begin working at the barbershop, Bread recounts the day of her job interview five years ago.

videos.title: Bread's Alopecia / Tiramisu
videos.overview: After his style is called "old-fashioned," Bread starts to lose hair due to stress. Can he find a trendy solution for both problems?

videos.title: Macaron's Holiday / Macaron
videos.overview: Thanks to a new friend, pop icon Macaron has a memorable birthday when she learns the importance of taking time for new adventures and fun experiences.

videos.title: Ice Cream Runaway / Ice Cream
videos.overview: When Scoopy leaves home to eat something warm, he begins melting on the sidewalk. Can Bread and friends help this ice cream stay cool and happy?

videos.title: Patrol Pretzel / Pretzel
videos.overview: New police officer Pretzel dreams of becoming a detective. But first, he must catch the Cheesestick Burglars to defend peace in Bakery Town.

videos.title: Cursed Mansion / Halloween
videos.overview: Lured in by the chance of finding treasure left behind by a ghostly couple, Bread, Wilk and Choco enter a haunted mansion for a spooky adventure.

videos.title: Butter's Sorrow / Butter
videos.overview: When Butter's handsome looks get him into trouble, the star turns to Bread for help with the unusual request to make him less attractive.

videos.title: Robot Wilk / Milk
videos.overview: Determined to turn Bread into toast, Potato Chip kidnaps Wilk in his basement lab and sends a lookalike robot to the barbershop in his place.

videos.title: Bread's Wisdom / Taiyaki
videos.overview: The Cake Queen asks Bread to make a decision when two taiyakis insist they are both the real mother to a baby fish-shaped cake.

videos.title: Staff Retreat / Croissant
videos.overview: The barbershop is busier than ever, and its employees are fried. To refresh, Wilk prepares a team-building event for everyone to enjoy.

videos.title: Cheese's Playground / Cheese
videos.overview: When Cheese gets kicked out of the playground because of his smell, he and Sausage come up with an idea to build a play area of their own.

videos.title: Crab or Cracker? / Snack
videos.overview: Bread uses his skills to give Gedori a scare when the young crabby snack insists on living in an aquarium with real fish.

videos.title: Magic Kettle / Dumpling
videos.overview: In return for a good deed, Wilk is given a magic kettle with a genie inside who offers to grant all of his wishes. Be careful what you wish for, Wilk!

videos.title: Chip's Chip / Potato Chip
videos.overview: Potato Chip's hair shop has no customers. The starchy stylist invents a computer chip to control and destroy his rival Bread once and for all.

videos.title: Cakes' Wedding / Cake
videos.overview: A heartbroken Cheesecake needs Bread's help to look amazing at a wedding where her ex-boyfriend and the princess are getting married.

videos.title: Chip and Sausage / Sausage
videos.overview: Bread and Potato Chip make a bet at the arcade: If Bread wins, he gets Potato Chip's car. If he loses, he has to give up a member of his staff.

videos.title: Bread's Crisis / Pie
videos.overview: Left alone with two broken arms after bossing his staff around, Bread thinks on his toes to keep the barbershop customers happy.

videos.title: Choco's Blind Date / Bagel
videos.overview: Choco is set up on a blind date with Bagel, who seems like a dreamy bachelor on paper but turns out to be a headache for Choco.

videos.title: Cursed Mirror / Twisted Bread
videos.overview: Wilk buys a mirror at the antique shop after hearing about its history. Little does he know, the mirror holds a hidden value and a curse.

videos.title: Princess and Cheese / Camembert Cheese
videos.overview: Princess Cake is lovestruck after getting her heart stolen by Cheese at her birthday party. If only she could see him again...

videos.title: Wilk became Bread / Donut
videos.overview: Wilk has always wished to be as good as Bread. When a fairy makes his wish come true, Wilk switches bodies with Bread and lives out his dream.

videos.title: Strawberry and Chocolate / Valentine's Day
videos.overview: On Valentine's Day, Romeo asks Bread to turn him from a chocolate cake to a strawberry cake so that he can finally marry his one true love Juliet.

videos.title: Brandon's Visit / Sliced Bread
videos.overview: When news spreads of Bread’s dad visiting the barbershop, the whole town gets in on a plan to turn the barber into a local celebrity.

videos.title: Wilk's Awakening / Cupcake
videos.overview: Feeling rotten about his job after a catch-up with friends, Wilk is asked to participate in a community event. Can he turn super molds into supermodels?

videos.title: The Barber's Apprentices / Melon Bread
videos.overview: Red Bean Bread visits Bread's Barbershop with his new pupil and proposes Melon Bread and Wilk compete in a hair battle.

videos.title: Cat Cupcakes
videos.overview: When rats attack the residents of Bakery Town, the Cake Queen looks for a sure solution — and someone to blame.

videos.title: Big Boy Wilk
videos.overview: Wilk becomes the hair shop's laughingstock when Bread finds out that his parents still treat him like a baby. Can Wilk learn to act his age?

videos.title: Chocolate Wall
videos.overview: Wondering what lies behind the town's great wall, Chocolate Boy raises the question to his grandmother, who has an answer — and a story to tell.

videos.title: Queen of calculation
videos.overview: After being replaced by Potato Chip's new robot cashier, Choco finds the brilliant math tutor, Mr. Naan, to sharpen her arithmetic skills.

videos.title: Take care of my hair
videos.overview: At a hairdressing competition where Bread is the record-holding champion, a new contestant joins in, looking to shake things up.

videos.title: Yoga Master
videos.overview: Bread attempts to learn yoga after miraculously recovering from a back injury with the help of a gummy yogi and therapist, Ms. Jelly.

videos.title: Steambun's Moving Day
videos.overview: A series of curious incidents at Bread's shop land Wilk and Choco in trouble. Can they figure out who's been trying to sabotage them?

videos.title: Ghost House
videos.overview: On Halloween, the barbershop trio tour a haunted mansion with performers who aren't spooky at all. Bread lends a hand so they can look the part.

videos.title: Wilk and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: On the way to run an errand for Bread, Wilk encounters a poor old lady who sells him beans that hold an extraordinary surprise.

videos.title: Country Milk, Bilk
videos.overview: When Wilk's cousin from the country comes to town, he impresses Bread with his dessert-making skills — until his passion gets the better of him.

videos.title: Three Rice Cakes
videos.overview: Bread narrowly escapes perils of many kinds and realizes that his life is in danger! Can he find out why he has a target on his back?

videos.title: The Gold, The Smart, and The Strong
videos.overview: When Sausage falls into Lake Sink during a camping trip, the lake's guardian offers Bread and Wilk a different sausage to take home.

videos.title: Time Machine
videos.overview: Jealous of Bread's success, Potato Chip decides to travel back in time and stop Bread from pursuing his dream as a hairdresser.

videos.title: Sugary Revenge
videos.overview: The crystal citizens of a sugary city decide to fight back against greedy baked goods — but first, they need Master Bread's help to get bigger.

videos.title: Macaron's Biggest Fan
videos.overview: At the Flavor of the Month Contest, Vanilla Ice Cream feels like he's too boring to win — until he gets a visit from Master Bread and Wilk.

videos.title: Flavor of the Month
videos.overview: At the Flavor of the Month Contest, Vanilla Ice Cream feels like he's too boring to win — until he gets a visit from Master Bread and Wilk.

videos.title: The Alley Barbershop
videos.overview: Bread is a contestant on "Alley Barbershop," a TV show that saves failing hair salons. Can the Master help three struggling barbers stay in business?

videos.title: Mommy Cake's Makeover
videos.overview: Choco recognizes that an overworked and underappreciated mom is due for a makeover — so for her birthday, Choco gives her a present she'll never forget.

videos.title: Great Expectations
videos.overview: After learning of the rising real estate prices in Bakery Town, Master Bread decides to renovate the barbershop and discovers a surprise in the walls.

videos.title: Choco's First Love
videos.overview: Choco runs into a special friend from high school and recounts to Master Bread and Wilk why the two never ended up together as kids. But is it too late?

videos.title: Bread the Fashion King
videos.overview: When Master Bread reads negative reviews about his poor fashion choices, he enlists the help of Andre Bun, a talented but sensitive clothing designer.

videos.title: Face of the King
videos.overview: After Cake Queen publicly humiliates Prince Butter Waffle, the prince asks Bread to give him a face that's fit for a king so he can take back the throne.

videos.title: Best Sausage Contest: Part 1
videos.overview: Bread enters Sausage into a Best Sausage Contest in hopes of winning the $1,000 prize — but the pup will have to compete against the queen's spoiled dog.

videos.title: Best Sausage Contest: Part 2
videos.overview: Cake Queen bribes Bread to style her dog for the beauty portion of the Best Sausage Contest. Wilk steps in to cover, but can he compete with the Master?

videos.title: Return of Donut Rangers
videos.overview: When Butter gets cast in the new "Donut Rangers" movie, fans Bread and Wilk vow to get the Red Donut his job back — by filming a brand-new series.

videos.title: Terminate Bread
videos.overview: An ecoconscious robot named the Breadinator tracks down Master Bread to share an important message about the future of the environment.

videos.title: Encounter of Moono
videos.overview: When Wilk lets the small alien fugitive, Moono, hide in the barbershop, he repays the favor by using his special powers to help out Bread and friends.
